title: Intimacy Pact
concept: Pleasure-First orientation + Warm Decline without penalty — Structure for the Alliance’s most vulnerable territory.
whenToUse: Initiating/declining tense; intimacy stall; after trust dent; preventive Structure in Phase 2–3.
steps: Orient Pleasure-First: invest in partner’s experience before only your own.
Agree: decline carries no relational penalty.
Install Warm Decline + alternative closeness options.
If contempt/safety issues → repair chapters first.

phrases.text: I want to be close — not in that space tonight. Can we hold each other?
Not about you. Can we do something together instead?
Not tonight — I do want to be near you. Is that okay?

working: Warm Decline + hold; no penalty. Next-day initiation lands. Pact holds.
notWorking: Decline met with cold “fine” or punishment — or initiation that ignores partner’s experience. Vulnerability becomes unsafe.
activity: Draft pact together (kit worksheet). Initial both. Review date on calendar.
